purpose: Find cells whose LST is unusual relative to land-cover peers, neighbours and own history

context_features.z_cover: robust z of relative LST within the cell's dominant WorldCover class
context_features.nb_resid: relative LST − mean of land cells within 1.5 km
context_features.hist_resid: relative LST 2024 − mean relative LST of earlier epochs (≥2 required)

interpretation_notes: Persistence = share of individual Landsat dates (2023–2025) on which the cell's scene-level LST deviates from its neighbours in the same direction as the anomaly; high persistence means the anomaly is not a compositing artefact.
limitations: Contamination (2 %) sets how many cells are flagged; anomalies are statistical, not hazards.
